BlockNumberOrTag.title: blockNumberOrTag
BlockNumberOrTag.description:
A block, given as its height in hex or as a tag. A height in decimal is rejected: the block is looked up by `Web3InformationRetriever`, which parses the number as hex and requires the `0x` prefix.

A string of `0x` and exactly 64 hex digits is always read as a 32-byte block hash, never as a height, so a height zero-padded to that length is not accepted. The hash is listed in `blockRefOrNumberOrTag`, the block parameter of the methods that read account state, rather than here: this union also describes the `...ByNumber` methods.
